U-CH-018.actual: GET /api/v1/chat/sessions/<id>/approval-mode answers 403 'Chat approval mode requires a local operator connection.' even from curl straight to 127.0.0.1 (no proxy, no cross-origin). In auth mode none the actor source is 'none' (plugins/auth.ts:180-182 returns there, before the loopback-bypass check is reached), and directLocal is never granted for that source, so the route refuses every call. This looks like a deliberate security rule (mode none cannot prove the caller is local); no document states it, and whether none-mode installs should be able to use Auto mode is a product decision, not decided here. What is defective regardless is the presentation: the row says 'unavailable' with a Retry that cannot succeed, gives no reason and no pointer to Settings › Access, and the browser console logs a 403 per load. For an operator whose goal is Auto mode or Managed files there is no path on screen. Who sees it: every mode-none install (packaged desktop, goatcitadel up, pnpm dev; the dev supervisor defaults to mode none, so its loopback bypass is not reached), in any conversation that belongs to a project. Docker (docker-compose.yaml:74-76 sets token mode with loopback bypass false) and proxied or remote setups likely see it as well because the request does not arrive as a direct loopback connection (unverified, not run). Token or basic mode with a direct loopback client does not get the 403 (code only, not run: the auth mode may not be changed in this review). While the row is shown the composer loses only the 'Use Auto mode' / 'Managed files' controls; sending, attachments, model and web options still work (checked live). Confirmed by the token-mode comparison (Task 13b, tk-ch-1-project.json): a project conversation in token mode shows 'Standard approvals / Use Auto mode', Auto mode turns on with no dialog and Managed files opens; mode-none installs therefore lose both. Settings > Access in mode none does not mention it (st-5-access.png); it is the natural place for the pointer. Whether mode-none installs should get Auto mode and Managed files is listed as a design decision.

Gateway and Mission Control did not both become ready.' (main.ts:173), 'Gateway not ready / UI not ready', a log path, and Retry, Open in Browser, Open Logs, Open Install Folder (main.ts:160-215). The cause, a recovery state and the last 100 log lines reach only the log, which 'Open Logs' opens. The Windows reserved-port message (bundled-postgres-runtime.ts:1139) is clear but also only in the log. Who meets it: a desktop install whose port 45432 is taken or that has a stale container from an earlier install.

This dialog is the only place in the Cockpit to enter a provider API key (the Inbox cannot take a secret): used by guided model setup on first run, Settings > Models and LibraryCandidatePlan.tsx. The one-line fix (read the value into a local before calling the setter) belongs in the first fix batch. Tests missed it: ChatChangePlanActionDialog.test.tsx:267 passes a hand-built event whose currentTarget is never nulled.
